status: Records now has a bounded native record-context read: one scoped workspace record plus its outgoing references, visible backlinks, principal mentions, suggestion metadata and transition timeline. The owner slice includes portable domain/application ports, a PostgreSQL adapter over the existing Records-owned tables, an owner-local HTTP router, a strict Next transport and configured GET cutover. The owner remains pending: registry list/search/paging, writes (create/update/archive/transition/reference/mention/suggestion), record-details supplements, attachments, recursive consumers and browser acceptance remain retained TypeScript. The native router is not mounted in shared composition.

scope.workflowBoundary: The qualified source slice is the existing GET /api/v1/holdings/{holding_slug}/records/{module}/{record_id} record-context read used by the record drawer. It returns the same record/detail keys as the retained reader: record, references, backlinks, mentions, suggestions and history. Registry list/search/paging, ?view=mention, every generic record write, record-details supplements, attachments, cross-owner consumers and all other Records workflows remain retained TypeScript.
scope.domain: Portable policy validates module/record identity bounds, selected scope (holding Company, exact branch, exact department), records.read, module access, non-archived/current status, bounded fields JSON, ordered/unique reference edges, bounded/unique backlinks, mention kinds/labels, suggestion JSON/state, transition timeline and exact wire keys. Bounds are 50 references, 50 backlinks, 200 mentions, 20 suggestions, 20 history rows, 64 fields, 64 KiB fields JSON and 16 KiB per suggestion JSON.
scope.application: record_context authorizes the current read fact, validates the module/record and module access, rechecks current assignment authority, asks the composition-owned cross-owner guard to admit the host record, reads the scoped row, filters every outgoing reference/backlink target through that guard, rejects source/guard failures closed, and returns the bounded document. The application opens no transaction and never reads HTTP.
scope.adapters: SQL is Records-owned: workspace_records, record_reference_edges, record_principal_mentions, record_field_suggestions and workspace_record_transitions. Current IAM is re-read through the existing assignments/iam_members/iam_assignment_active/iam_principal_active/iam_role_allows predicates. No other owner row is selected, linked or mutated. Cross-owner link admission is supplied by the public guard port; the crate contains no cross-owner SQL. The caller's serializable Holding transaction is mandatory and is not opened, committed or retried here.
scope.http: Owner-local GET /api/v1/holdings/{holding_slug}/records/{module_id}/{record_id}. Exact registered Host/Holding targets, HTTPS origins, empty query and body, bounded path identifiers, private/no-store plus no-referrer/nosniff responses and bounded BusinessError status mapping. The composition backend owns Account session resolution, selected Company/branch/department scope, current IAM/module facts, cross-owner admission and the serializable owner unit.
scope.transport: ERPX_NATIVE_RECORDS_CONFIG is strictly validated: literal loopback private base, reserved ports 3000/3001/3100/3101/3103/5432/5433/5435/8080 and 3200-3299 excluded, exact HTTPS Holding origins, unique hosts/slugs, 250..30000 ms timeout, bounded Host/cookie/context values, exact data/context shapes, Company/context equality, unique ordered targets, denied-reference sentinel and a 2 MiB response bound. A configured failure never falls back to the retained reader.
scope.nextCutover: packages/workplace/src/routes/api/v1/holdings/[holdingSlug]/records/[module]/[id]/route.ts GET uses native context when ERPX_NATIVE_RECORDS_CONFIG is present and the normal WorkContext has authority/IAM facts. An absent configuration retains recordContext. Once configured, a malformed or failed native read is mapped to the existing ApiError response surface and never replaced by the retained reader. ?view=mention remains retained.
scope.ssrLimit: There is no dedicated SSR page that renders this record-context document today; the cutover is the Next server route consumed by the existing record drawer. The transport is server-only and available to an SSR consumer, but no SSR page render is claimed.
scope.crossOwnerGuards: The native layer never reads another owner's SQL. RecordContextGuard::authorize_source and target_visible must be implemented at composition using owning public ports. A denied target keeps the retained drawer behavior (reference becomes Unavailable record, backlink is hidden). A guard transport/owner failure fails the whole read closed. The guard is not implemented or mounted in shared composition by this slice.
scope.notClaimed: No browser journey, authenticated page render, shared composition mount, catalogue acceptance qualification, list/search/paging, record write, reference/mention/suggestion command, attachment read, SSR page render, deployment, staging, private production or Cloudflare verification.
